testCase.name: [dev] S18 Two sessions: a stale editor on the other device must not write a deleted item back

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S18 「两个会话：另一台设备上过期的编辑器不能把删掉的条目写回去」 Two sessions: a stale editor on the other device must not write a deleted item back

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again.（UAT TC-24；TFA-94699 AC 5；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Same account signed in twice (A and B, each with its own email code); the Hospital chart open on both; on B the pre-round notes editor is open showing both points and Post-Round shows the tasks

When A deletes the point 'Check heel ulcer dressing' and the task 'Call daughter re: goals of care'. B, without reloading, adds the point 'Recheck potassium at noon' and the task 'Order echo'. Repeat in Nursing Home.

Then On A, on B and on the server the new point and task are there and the deleted ones are not

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 5 ('never comes back unless re-dictated'); a write from a stale copy is not re-dictation. Checkpoints on A after B saved: mustContain the new items, mustNotContain 'heel ulcer' and 'goals of care'; plus a server read. A deleted Nursing Home point that comes back is known TFA-92590 (stale importantPointsDraft, oracleRules 5).

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
